```{python}
#| label: fig-rtl-flow
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "RTL synthesis flow with open-source tools: the behavioral description is verified by simulation, synthesized and mapped to the standard-cell library, and re-verified; static timing analysis, test-logic insertion, and power analysis complete the front-end before physical synthesis. Failed checks loop back to the behavioral description."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyArrowPatch, FancyBboxPatch, Polygon


def box(ax, x, y, text, w=3.4, h=1.0, kind='proc'):
    if kind == 'term':
        # shrink by the pad so the padded outer edge matches w x h exactly
        p = 0.08
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x - w / 2 + p, y - h / 2 + p),
                                    w - 2 * p, h - 2 * p,
                                    boxstyle=f'round,pad={p}',
                                    fc='#f4e8d8', ec='k', lw=1.0))
    elif kind == 'data':
        ax.add_patch(Polygon([(x - w / 2 + 0.3, y - h / 2),
                              (x + w / 2 + 0.3, y - h / 2),
                              (x + w / 2 - 0.3, y + h / 2),
                              (x - w / 2 - 0.3, y + h / 2)],
                             closed=True, fc='#e8f4e8', ec='k', lw=1.0))
    elif kind == 'dec':
        ax.add_patch(Polygon([(x - w / 2, y), (x, y + h / 2 + 0.2),
                              (x + w / 2, y), (x, y - h / 2 - 0.2)],
                             closed=True, fc='#fdf3d0', ec='k', lw=1.0))
    else:
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x - w / 2, y - h / 2), w, h, fc='#e8eef4',
                               ec='k', lw=1.0))
    ax.text(x, y, text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8)


def arr(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, label=None):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x0, y0), (x1, y1), arrowstyle='->',
                                 mutation_scale=11, lw=1.0,
                                 shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0))
    if label:
        ax.text((x0 + x1) / 2 + 0.15, (y0 + y1) / 2, label, fontsize=8)


fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 8.2))

# column 1
box(ax, 2.5, 13.2, 'Specification', kind='term')
box(ax, 2.5, 11.6, 'Behavioral description\n(VHDL, SystemVerilog)', kind='data')
box(ax, 2.5, 10.0, 'Behavioral verification\n(iverilog, verilator)')
box(ax, 2.5, 8.4, 'OK?', w=1.6, h=0.8, kind='dec')
box(ax, 2.5, 6.8, 'RTL synthesis +\nlibrary mapping (yosys, abc)')
box(ax, 2.5, 5.2, 'Gate-level netlist', kind='data')

arr(ax, 2.5, 12.7, 2.5, 12.1)
arr(ax, 2.5, 11.1, 2.5, 10.5)
arr(ax, 2.5, 9.5, 2.5, 9.0)
arr(ax, 2.5, 7.8, 2.5, 7.3, 'y')
arr(ax, 2.5, 6.3, 2.5, 5.7)
# loop back on 'n'
ax.plot([1.7, 0.5, 0.5], [8.4, 8.4, 11.6], 'k-', lw=1.0)
arr(ax, 0.5, 11.6, 0.8, 11.6)
ax.text(1.0, 8.6, 'n', fontsize=8)

# column 2
box(ax, 7.0, 5.2, 'Simulation or formal\nverification (iverilog)')
box(ax, 7.0, 3.6, 'OK?', w=1.6, h=0.8, kind='dec')
box(ax, 7.0, 2.0, 'Timing analysis\n(opensta)')
arr(ax, 4.2, 5.2, 5.3, 5.2)
arr(ax, 7.0, 4.7, 7.0, 4.2)
arr(ax, 7.0, 3.0, 7.0, 2.5, 'y')
# n: debug branch (stub into void)
arr(ax, 7.8, 3.6, 8.7, 3.6)
ax.text(8.0, 3.85, 'n: debug', fontsize=8)

# column 3
box(ax, 11.5, 5.2, 'Test-logic insertion\n(fault)')
box(ax, 11.5, 3.6, 'Verification +\npower analysis')
box(ax, 11.5, 2.0, 'OK?', w=1.6, h=0.8, kind='dec')
box(ax, 11.5, 0.5, 'To physical synthesis', kind='term')
# single arrow only at the end (into test-logic insertion)
ax.plot([8.7, 9.25, 9.25], [2.0, 2.0, 5.2], 'k-', lw=1.0)
arr(ax, 9.25, 5.2, 9.8, 5.2)
arr(ax, 11.5, 4.7, 11.5, 4.1)
arr(ax, 11.5, 3.1, 11.5, 2.6)
arr(ax, 11.5, 1.4, 11.5, 1.0, 'y')
# n: rearchitect branch (stub into void)
arr(ax, 12.3, 2.0, 13.2, 2.0)
ax.text(12.5, 2.25, 'n: rearchitect', fontsize=8)

ax.set_xlim(0, 14.2)
ax.set_ylim(-0.2, 13.9)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
